brief:
A new book by Andrew Feinstein examines how weapons manufacturers profited from the conflict in Gaza, according to Middle East Eye. The investigation tracks roughly $50 billion in gains connected to the ongoing violence, highlighting the financial incentives embedded in the arms trade.

The work appears to focus on major defense contractors including BAE Systems, mapping the intersection between military equipment sales and civilian casualties across conflict zones in the Middle East.

title: Book traces $50 billion in arms industry profits from Gaza conflict
